review_basis:
Twenty-first golden, a fresh, previously-untouched Maine BGS heat-pump-upgrade project (a small, multi-part file; only the first part's own two mechanical sheets carry vector linework). A text-anchored scan of sheet M-101 found abundant real `3/4" CD` / `1" CD` condensate-drain callouts serving several ductless indoor units (IU-19, IU-12, and others). A render crop showed a real, clean horizontal `3/4" CD` main running along a corridor, with several real tee take-offs down to individual unit traps (drawn as circled 'T' symbols) -- a legible, uncluttered real mechanical plan, a clear step down in complexity from the VA Durham sheet this session's own most recent goldens came from.

`trace_run` reaches this horizontal main cleanly (17.05 LF, matching the visible span) with a real `dead_end` at the left end (a real wall-penetration stub connecting to a `3/4" CD RISE` vertical drop near room UTIL-007, confirmed via marked crop) and a real `ambiguous` stop at the right end (a real elbow into a leader-connected fitting near indoor unit IU-12, a genuine fork). This project's own sheets, like several others already established this session, carry no PDF layer names, driving the same automatic-bind miss; a manual size override is used. The run's own bench-style reseed (40% into its single segment) was independently re-verified live and reproduces the identical result.
scope: A single real 3/4-inch condensate-drain (CD) pipe main (17.05 LF) on a Maine BGS heat-pump-upgrade project's own first-floor mechanical plan, sheet M-101, from a real wall-penetration stub near room UTIL-007 to a real elbow/fitting fork near indoor unit IU-12. Explicitly OUT OF SCOPE: the `3/4" CD RISE` vertical drop the left end connects to; the real tee take-offs along the main's own length feeding individual unit traps; the fork's own continuation past the right end; the separate refrigerant liquid/suction (L/S) piping run shown parallel below this main (a different system, not attempted this pass); sheet M-102 and every other sheet on this real multi-part plan set.
